title: 美国威士忌协会CEO：全球出口增长2.5%，唯独加拿大拖后腿
speaker: Michael Valelo

segments.en: And by the way, American whiskey is about over a billion dollar export for the U.S. economy.
segments.zh: 顺便说一句，美国威士忌对美国经济来说是超过10亿美元的出口产品。

segments.en: So at the same time, by the way, American whiskey and U.S. Spirit exports grew by about 2.5% everywhere else except Canada.
segments.zh: 与此同时，美国威士忌和烈酒在除加拿大以外的全球市场增长了约2.5%。

segments.en: So to put things in perspective, this prohibiting American whiskey on those shelves really did have an impact on the category, but also U.S. Spirit in general.
segments.zh: 因此，从全局看，禁止美国威士忌上架确实对该品类乃至整个美国烈酒行业造成了影响。
